resolutions: Frequentative shape is a lexical user choice because Andrews gives no strict rule predicting which shape cooperates with a stem; copied Source sounds are automatic.
The three ordinary frequentative shapes apply to any compatible open typed Source and Canvas examples do not form a stem whitelist.
Short-glottal meaning focus defaults to open and becomes a user choice only when final semantic composition needs a particular distributive scope.
Patient scope is licensed only when the typed Source has an object; participant carriers and finite realization remain automatic.
Known supportive or real initial i is an automatic Source fact; only an unresolved initial-i history exposes the existing Source choice.
Supportive-i deletion and copied following-syllable material are derived automatically, while exceptional real-i treatment remains available through the real-i analysis.
Recursive reduplication count is a genuine emphasis choice and every additional layer is realized by the same canonical frequentative operation.
Reduplication target appears only when fused tla or a mainline reflexive before supportive i makes that target choice structurally real.
Fused tla, lexical-stem, and combined reduplication retain distinct object and event scopes; copied sounds and participant structure are automatic.
Partial reflexive reduplication is restricted to short-glottal formation before a supportive initial i, which is deleted automatically.
Special intransitive destockal frequentatives are admitted by final ni or hui shape, never by example-stem membership.
The intransitive destockal route changes only the stock vowel and destockal suffix, assigns Class A, and reuses the selected Voice formation for nonactive or impersonal structure.
Special causative destockal frequentatives are admitted by n-a, ni-ā, or hu-a shape, retain causative a and typed objects, and assign Class B.
Canvas examples and lexical readings remain reading evidence and cannot authorize, block, or supply a Source stem.
The new Reduplication target control records only a genuine structural choice; suffix replacement, stock-vowel realization, class, perfective, and finite surface remain automatic.
Extinct and fused destockal frequentatives are admitted by a completed ca or tz-a Source shape and typed history, never by membership in the Canvas example list.
A fused stock vowel remains long automatically, while an ambiguous tz-a Result retains both causative and applicative readings until context requires a role choice.
A completed frequentative destockal Result may be recaptured for the next derivation; applicative replaces tz-a with ch-i and adds liā, while rare Type-two causative replaces ca with qui-l-tiā.
Applicative and rare Type-two routes import only the participant chosen by the user, preserve earlier typed objects, derive hierarchy and class, and do not infer the rejected tla fusion.
Uncertain ca is an explicit analysis on an open compatible root, not an example-stem whitelist or a claim about the root's lexical meaning.
The uncertain-ca route derives the copied prefix and ca or tz-a suffix from Source shape and exposes causative versus applicative only when the intended participant structure needs it.
Fused tla in the uncertain-ca family is a genuine selected structural analysis that lowers valence; it is not inferred from a Canvas gloss such as bark or growl.
Authorized sound assimilation follows the assembled morphophonological shape and is never a separate user choice or a lexical admission gate.
Uncertain tz-ca formation is admitted by a replaceable final Source syllable on an open intransitive Source, never by membership in the Canvas examples.

The operation replaces the final syllable with tz-ca and derives the copied initial material automatically; lexical meaning and uncertain historical explanation remain non-authorizing reading evidence.
A stem already containing unreduplicated tz-ca and a transitive tz-ca stem keep different Source analyses instead of being forced through the frequentative replacement path.
An owner-issued nonactive Result may be recaptured for any ordinary frequentative shape while its voice, participant topology, selected Mood, and selected Tense remain continuous.
The separate-individual-acts reading is derived from frequentative formation on the nonactive collective action and is not an extra participant-distribution control.
